answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: Just to remind you, the shift is Monday from 7:55pm to 3:55am, wound care in Jersey City at 40 dollars an hour. Would you like to take this shift? For anything else, the office can help after this call.

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: Thanks for considering the shift, and I understand you need to mull it over. Have a great day and talk to you later!
